subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select "no substitution required".**

The Yoruba was (one of the west African city - state culture).

options.text: one of the west African city - state cultures
one of a west African city - state cultures
one of the west's African city - state culture

solution:
The correct answer is: **One of the West African city-state cultures**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence is grammatically incorrect as it is missing the plural "**cultures**" to match the subject "**one of the west African city-state cultures.**
